## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL with a mild Value/cyclical tilt; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed internals with Financials/Energy/Healthcare showing strength while large Tech names display short-term RECOVERYs — plus a major divergence among big-cap techs (≥3 majors with 1W ≠ 1M). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology in top performers).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Financials lead: JPM (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +9.60%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND; Energy showing upside flow: XOM (1W: +4.14% | 1M: -6.81%) RECOVERY, CVX (1W: +3.29% | 1M: -7.61%) RECOVERY. Healthcare steady: JNJ (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +8.62%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities lag: CEG (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -9.40%) BELOW TREND; Communication weak: CHTR (1W: -5.58% | 1M: +6.95%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary soft with pockets of stress: TSLA (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +16.14% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +13.95% | 1M: -20.53%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +10.76% | 1M: -7.23%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: LRCX (1W: -20.63% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -20.17% | 1M: +10.52%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -16.19% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -9.01% | 1M: -0.04%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in semiconductors and select Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +16.14% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +13.95% | 1M: -20.53%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence: AAPL (1W: +10.26% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +5.50% | 1M: -9.16%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -9.94%) RECOVERY — this MAJOR DIVERGENCE suppresses a strong regime call.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with many short-term bounces; AAPL (1W: +10.26% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +9.42% | 1M: -1.82%) RECOVERY, ASML (1W: -7.21% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND. Sector showing pockets of strength but 1M weakness keeps caution; Tech participation is uneven within the 7/11 positive-week reading.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Healthy and broad leadership: JPM (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +9.60%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.09% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +10.35%) ABOVE TREND. Financials are confirming sector-level strength and are key contributors to the neutral-market tone.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive and constructive: JNJ (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +8.62%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +9.80%) ABOVE TREND. Bullish news flow (ABBV +80, TMO +80) supports selective upside.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and select cyclicals while monitoring tech bounces as tactical plays; reduce exposure to pressured semiconductors and weak Industrials exhibiting confirmed BELOW TRENDs. Style: Value/cyclical tilt within a NEUTRAL regime; treat big-tech RECOVERYs as tactical rather than core re-allocations.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: n/a | 1M: n/a) (+80 news) — price action to confirm. BEARISH: LRCX (1W: -20.63% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -20.17% | 1M: +10.52%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -16.19% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Financials (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +7.14%) — breadth support. BEARISH: Semiconductors/Technology pockets where multiple names are BELOW TREND or in CORRECTION; Utilities also showing weakness (CEG BELOW TREND).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch JPM near recent breakout levels for continuation of Financials strength; monitor AAPL (1W: +10.26% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY for follow-through above the near-term pivot; NVDA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -9.94%) RECOVERY needs to reclaim its 1M trend to confirm a sustainable tech reversal. Semicap names (LRCX, AMAT) breaking lower would widen sector stress.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ABBV (+80): Tepkinly approval discussion — cross-ref price showing strength in Healthcare cohort, sentiment confirming accumulation. TMO (+80): FBI approval headline supporting stock; price action aligned with sector ABOVE TREND. CSCO (+75): Raised guidance — price action showing RECOVERY/strength within Tech (confirming).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
GE (-60): Industrial downgrade pressure — GE-related weakness aligns with some Industrials underperforming; price confirming risk. ORCL (-50): Negative AI outlook and large H1 drawdown — price BELOW TREND/weakness confirmed. AMAT (-50): Memory-sector negative headlines and 1W/1M mix (1W down, 1M up → CORRECTION) — divergence to monitor for further distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/cyclical tilt as Financials and select cyclicals show leadership while Tech exhibits short-term RECOVERYs. Stocks showing relative strength: SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +9.60%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +16.14% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY. Key risk: major divergence among big-cap techs (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/META RECOVERYs) and clustered semiconductor stress (LRCX/AMAT/INTC BELOW TREND) — news sentiment on ORCL/AMAT amplifies downside risk.
